description.narrative: Stöd till a) Införande av ett Energiledningssystem i en pilotkommun och stöd till energieffektivisering och förnybar energi i flerfamiljshus, och b) Analys av möjligheter till utvecklande av en nationell model för uppskalning och replikering.

Support to a) Establishment of an Energy Management System in a pilot Municipality and support to energy efficiency and renewable energy measures, and b) Analyzing the possiblities for upscaling the model on the national level.

The project is designed in the context of agreed strategic priorities for supporting development outcomes in Armenia. This project directly responds to the need to progress to adjust transition to low carbon development in Armenia with involvement of communities in implementation of stated objectives under Paris Agreement, integrating poverty alleviation efforts with climate action to address the multidimensional aspects of poverty in Armenia.
Project's overall objective: Enhance the economic, environmental, and social resilience of an secondary town/municipality in Armenia by developing, piloting and scaling a model for economic empowerment and low carbon development that can be replicated in other communities of the country.
The expected project outcomes are: 1. A proven model of energy efficiency (EE) and renewable energy (RE) for replication and accelerated impact. 2. Reduction in the carbon dioxide emissions due to the implemented measures over time. 3. Support to stronger economy, stronger connectivity and crosscutting deliverables.
